### God In The Storm
Author: Jennifer Benson Schuldt
Site: Our Daily Bread
URL: https://military.odb.org/god-in-the-storm/
Passage: Job 37:23
Points:
- Watching a fierce storm unfold displays the overwhelming might present in creation.
- Elihu highlights thunder and lightning to remind Job of God's sovereign power over nature.
- The majesty of the storm exposes how fragile and limited human beings truly are.
- The almighty God who commands the storm cares for our weaknesses and supplies us with His strength.

### The Wonders of His Weather: Sensing God’s Majesty in the Storm
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/the-wonders-of-his-weather
Passage: Job 37:14
Points:
- Modern conveniences and weather forecasts often dull our sense of wonder at God's majesty in nature.
- Elihu directs Job's focus toward rain, snow, thunder, and lightning as direct commissions from God.
- Uncontrollable weather halts human plans and works, reminding us of our frailty and limited understanding.
- The terrifying rumble of God's power brings dread to His enemies but secure awe to His redeemed children.
- Taking time to pause and contemplate God's wonders in storms fosters genuine humility and spiritual health.
